newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks down as foreign funds stay away.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks down as foreign funds stay away.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended marginally lower Thursday as foreign funds stayed away and local investors took profits.
Bogota's IBB index fell 0.39 percent to 1,032.82 amid a 1.9 billion peso volume, while Medellin's IBOMED index drifted down 0.63 percent to 16,090.82 amid a 2.8 billion peso volume.
"There was no real drop in trading volume but there had been rises in past days and we were expecting a certain level of price correction," one Bogota trader said.
He added that foreign funds showed little interest in trading Thursday.
Brewing giant Bavaria fell 2.2 percent to 6,600 in Bogota but gained 1.49 percent to close at 6,800 in Medellin. Banco Ganadero gained 0.31 percent to end at 319 on the Bogota exchange.
In Medellin Bancoquia bank lost 1.71 percent, down to 2,899.5 while cement manufacturer Cemento Argos remained unchanged at 7,000 pesos.
